business: Goldstein Divorce and Family Law Group
summary: A flat fee offer and two Toronto offices are strengths, but a contact form that appears to have no submit button and repeated copy cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: The contact form lists fields but appears to show no submit button, and the Yes and No options and consent line show no visible controls.
findings.cost: A person ready to call a family lawyer may not be able to send the form.
findings.fix: A tested form with a clear send button and confirmation.

findings.problem: The header shows 416-519-5552 while the Toronto office lists 416-646-2090, and the brand appears as GOLDSTEIN and Goldstein.
findings.cost: Mixed numbers and names confuse people who want to call.
findings.fix: One clear number per office and one brand style.

findings.problem: The social label reads Faccebook Page, the text says 'trust her' when it means plural lawyers, and the logo appears to be a blank placeholder.
findings.cost: Typos and a missing logo undermine trust in a law firm.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a working logo.

findings.problem: Please contact us for an honest evaluation of your case repeats at least five times, and the Testimonials page shows no visible reviews.
findings.cost: Repeated lines and no visible proof weaken your strongest selling point.
findings.fix: Varied, helpful copy and real client reviews.

redesign: A tested enquiry form and click to call for both offices.
Proofread copy with a clean logo and brand.
Visible client reviews and a clear fee explanation.
